decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, while also utilizing Faerie Mastermind and Phantom Interference to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Enduring Curiosity and Anoint with Affliction provide card advantage, while powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Floodpits Drowner apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Spyglass Siren and Preacher of the Schism for additional control and tempo advantage.

The Gruul Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies, utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger and Monstrous Rage to quickly pressure opponents. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Burst Lightning and Scorching Dragonfire to maintain board control. With a mix of creatures with haste and direct damage spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents early in the game and close out matches quickly before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Snakeskin Veil and Soulstone Sanctuary helps protect key creatures and provide additional value in longer games.
